title: Unscrupulous Airbnb host tries to get $1,700 out of Redditor with AI-generated pic of overflowing toilet
key_facts: A Redditor says an Airbnb host, described as one of the biggest Airbnb companies in their Australian state, tried to get $1,700 from them for an overflowed toilet.
The evidence offered for the overflow was an AI-generated picture, according to the Reddit post PC Gamer relays.
Google's Gemini chatbot was able to detect its own SynthID watermark (an invisible marker Google adds to AI images) in the fake image.
The post was shared on the r/isthisAI subreddit, where the picture was already suspected to be fake.
The poster later wrote that the case was resolved and the reimbursement the host asked for was deemed ineligible.
The poster also noted there was a floor underneath, so a few inches of water would have flooded the floor below.
PC Gamer's writer advises taking photos and videos of any Airbnb just before leaving.
quote_evidence: Gemini is able to spot its own SynthID watermark in the fake image.
I had this case resolved and deemed ineligible for the reimbursement they asked for...
take pictures and record videos of any Airbnbs you stop at just before you leave.
why_it_matters_hint: AI image tools make it easy to fake damage evidence, and AI tools can also help spot the fakes.
event_date: Not stated (a Reddit post; PC Gamer article dated 2 Oct 2026).
notes: Single outlet relaying one Reddit post; not independently confirmed. Host and platform decision are the poster's account. Date of the Reddit post not stated.
